00_audit_snapshot: EviBench algorithms are execution-ready for the audited temporal-imputation scope.
All 17 canonical algorithms have verified runtime evidence.
01_dataset_characterization: London AQ synthetic dataset has 600 timestamps, 140 nodes, 4 pollutants, zero natural missingness.
02_missingness_characterization: MCAR, MAR, MNAR mechanisms were injected at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5 rates on 30 realizations each.
03_algorithm_lifecycle: All 17 algorithms are execution-ready; DL models followed a documented train-validation-test lifecycle.
Training curves confirm convergence. Only test-phase results are used for performance claims.
04_comparisons: 405 thesis-ready test results across 18 comparison specs support controlled, scenario-wise analysis.
Classical baselines and DL temporal methods are compared under identical missingness contracts.
05_storyboards: Every comparison spec carries a narrative storyboard defining allowed claims, blocked claims, and caveats.
06_gates: All 10 Chapter 04 evidence packs pass gate verification (10/10 PASS).

caveats: Train/validation DL records are lifecycle evidence ONLY — not final test-performance claims.
Performance claims are specific to the synthetic London AQ benchmark, its artificial missingness protocols, and tested configurations.
Conformance verdicts are derived from static source-code probes (not dynamic behavioral tests).
Diagnosis-lane runs (diag_londonaq_*) are excluded from official evidence via --exclude-diagnosis.
UI screenshots (07_ui_screenshots) are manually captured at 1440×1000 with JSON sidecars.
